name: IdolsNFT
fix_description: In _beforeTokenTransfer, do not delete claimedSnapshots[_from] when balance reaches 0. Instead, keep the snapshot value so that if the user re-acquires an NFT, they cannot re-claim previously claimed rewards. The current delete allows repeated reward claims by cycling NFT ownership.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward logic bug exploit: deploy a contract constructor to bypass an isContract check, then repeatedly self-transfer the same NFT to trigger duplicate reward accounting. It involves only a few simple steps, no flash loans or complex DeFi mechanics, and the PoC is short and easy to derive from the vulnerable reward-on-transfer logic.
